about: Team values for Spec 2 (HotSummary context, joint-pattern detector, daily loop, bandit). Proposed by the AI lead on 2026-11-15 for team approval. Every entry carries a label and a source; none is a clinical limit. Read by backend/daily_loop.py (load_values).

values.name: sleep_need_min
values.label: Earth reference, no space data
values.source: Watson NF et al. Recommended Amount of Sleep for a Healthy Adult: A Joint Consensus Statement of the AASM and SRS. Sleep 2015;38(6):843-844 (adults should sleep 7 or more hours per night). doi:10.5665/sleep.4716. Sleep debt = sum of nightly shortfall below this over the last 3 days.

values.name: co2_limit_mmhg
values.label: NASA-STD-3001 (space standard)
values.source: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 V2 6004: average one-hour ppCO2 limited to 3 mmHg (same source as tools/cabin_dose_replay.py; compared against the cabin_pco2_1h Reading).

values.name: follow_up_h
values.label: team value
values.source: Spec 2: follow-up window 24-72 h by indicator, team value. Slow indicators (resting heart rate, joint patterns) get the longest window.

values.name: reversal_sigma
values.label: team value
values.source: team value: a drift counts as reversed when the latest value is back within this many sd of the person's normal (Anchor for drift, Adaptive baseline for acute), or the Alert has cleared. Same size as min_sigma in content/profiles/detection-cut-offs.json.

values.name: driver_rules
values.label: team value
values.source: team value: a context value at or past these makes that driver 'likely' in the plan text (suggestion, not diagnosis). dose_7d 7 mGy is twice the about 0.5 mGy/day ISS total dose in replay/iss-cabin-dose-RR-1.json (NASA OSDR EDA).

values.name: joint
values.unit: days / EWMA weight / per day / days / count / 0-1 / share of the score
values.label: team value
values.source: Mahalanobis distance on smoothed residuals: Mahalanobis PC 1936 (Proc Natl Inst Sci India 2:49-55); limit: Hotelling T-squared upper control limit for individual observations with estimated mean and covariance, NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook 6.5.4.3: https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/pmc/section5/pmc543.htm . Shrinkage toward the diagonal: Ledoit O, Wolf M. J Multivar Anal 2004;88(2):365-411, doi:10.1016/S0047-259X(03)00096-4. Tuned on the four PMData crew replays (tools/test_joint_pattern.py): train_days 28 (same as the Adaptive baseline window): 0.009 false joint alerts per crew-day and 3 of 4 injected 1 sd drifts caught within 12 days; 21 days: 0.004 but only 2 of 4 caught; false_alarm_p 0.01 or smoothing 0.15 raised false alerts without catching more; persist 2 vs 3 changed little.

values.name: bandit
values.label: team value
values.source: Linear Thompson sampling: Agrawal S, Goyal N. Thompson Sampling for Contextual Bandits with Linear Payoffs. ICML 2013, PMLR 28(3):127-135. Prior means from content/plans/warm-start.json (what-if forecast, backend/forecast_b.py); warm_start_scale 10 turns its readiness change /10 back into readiness points, so the bias is the predicted readiness gain.
